context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (Analytics Dashboard, Order Management, Creator Badges) are working correctly. Backend APIs tested: /api/orders, /api/orders/stats/summary, /api/creators/{id}/badge, /api/analytics/business, /api/analytics/creator/{id}. Frontend pages tested: /analytics, /orders, /creator/{id}. Navigation buttons for Orders and Analytics are visible in Dashboard nav bar.

analytics_dashboard.details: Page loads at /analytics, shows Business Overview with projects/spending/creators stats, Order Statistics section with all status counts, Subscription Status section

creator_badges.details: Badge endpoint /api/creators/{id}/badge returns badge type, badge_info (color, label, icon), and stats. CreatorBadge component displays on creator profile page. Badge calculation considers: premium status, completed projects, average rating, response time, verification status
